Kuvitus: curlinghalli. Vasemmalla heittä: Illustration: a curling hall. On the left the curler has slid in a low delivery position and released the stone, and the outstretched hand is already far from the stone. In the middle a curling stone with a red handle slides to the right on the ice, with a thin trail behind it. Two sweepers move ahead of the stone with their brooms against the ice. On the right, in the ice, are the rings of the target area with two stones already in them.
Kaksi kuvaa liukuvasta curlingkivestä. V: Two pictures of a sliding curling stone. On the left the situation picture: the stone slides to the right on the ice, and above it a thin blue arrow v shows the velocity to the right. The curler's hand has been left far behind. On the right the force diagram: the stone as a rectangle. The weight G points down from the centre, the normal force N of the ice points up from the bottom surface at the same length, and the small friction force of the ice points to the left from the rear corner of the bottom surface. There is no forward-pointing force. The picture is not to scale: the arrow of the friction force is drawn longer than the real one for clarity.
Ylhäällä tilannekuva: kaksi luistelijaa: At the top the situation picture: two skaters stand facing each other on the ice and push each other with their palms. On the left is a large adult A, on the right a smaller child B. At the bottom the force diagram of each separately, the skater as a rectangle. In the diagram of A: the weight G A down from the centre, the normal force N A of the ice up from the bottom surface and the force of B on A, F B A, pointing to the left and ending at the right side of A. In the diagram of B: the weight G B, which is shorter than the weight of A, the normal force N B and the force of A on B, F A B, pointing to the right and ending at the left side of B. The arrows F B A and F A B are equally long. Friction is ignored.
Kaksi kuvaa autosta, joka ajaa suoralla: Two pictures of a car driving along a straight road at constant velocity. On the left the situation picture: the car and above it a thin blue arrow v to the right. On the right the force diagram of the car, the car as a rectangle. The weight G down from the centre and the normal force N of the road up from the bottom surface, equally long. The force F of the road on the tyres starts from the front corner of the bottom surface and points forwards, and the air resistance F d starts from the rear side of the car and points backwards. The horizontal arrows are equally long, so the forces cancel each other.
Kaksi kuvaa matkustajakoneesta, joka len: Two pictures of a passenger aircraft flying horizontally at constant velocity. On the left the situation picture: the aircraft and above it a thin blue arrow v to the right. On the right the force diagram of the aircraft, the aircraft as a rectangle. The weight G down from the centre and the lift F lift of the wings up, equally long. The thrusts F 1 and F 2 of the two engines start from the front edge of the fuselage and point forwards, and they are equally long. The air resistance F d starts from the rear edge and points backwards, and it is as long as the thrusts together. The horizontal forces cancel each other, and the vertical forces cancel each other.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa, keksitty esimerkk: Graph to scale, invented example data. On the horizontal axis the time from zero to 0.20 seconds, on the vertical axis the reading of the sensor in newtons from minus five to five, the positive direction to the right. Two series of points at intervals of a hundredth of a second. The readings of the sensor of the light cart A, the dark series, are zero until 0.05 seconds, fall to about minus four newtons at 0.10 seconds and return to zero at 0.15 seconds. The readings of the heavy cart B, the red series, rise at the same moments to about plus four newtons and return to zero.
Mallikuvio. Vasemmalla tilannekuva: lamp: Model diagram. On the left the situation picture: a lamp hangs at rest from the ceiling on a vertical cord. On the right the force diagram of the lamp, the lamp as a rectangle: the weight G down from the centre and the tension T of the cord up from the top surface, equally long. There are no other forces.
